correctness.rationale: An exact link/deletion computation shows that deleting the first inner spine vertex gives a join of star higher-independence complexes, homotopic to (a-1)c three-spheres. Its link is a union of two cones over the star complex on c leaves, yielding c-1 two-spheres. Since the deletion has vanishing pi_2, the attaching inclusion is null and the cofiber adds c-1 three-spheres. The union is therefore ac-1 three-spheres integrally for all a,c>=1. The standalone program constructs faces independently and checks original, deletion and link mod-two ranks and Euler across 21 parameter pairs. Finite checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The first two-unwhiskered-vertex double-broom family sits outside the principal earlier exact-graph classes and is a natural two-parameter caterpillar subclass. Knowing that all tree r-independence complexes are shellable does not give exact Betti ranks or uniform homotopy dimensions. The precise quadratic multiplicity ac-1 is a complete integral homotopy classification, with a reusable null-attaching-map structural mechanism and explicit contractibility threshold.
